summary: Full backend + frontend verification of Bright at Home Cleaning preview. All 12 pytest backend tests pass (12/12). Playwright UI flows all pass: home loads with no console errors, Commercial section h2 uses font-serif, quote form submits successfully and shows 'Request received!', careers form submits and shows thank-you, /admin login renders the Submissions Dashboard fully (Trash2 regression fixed — no blank screen), and the delete-submission button removes a row and decrements the count (4 -> 3). Email forwarding verified via backend logs: 'FormSubmit forward [200]: {"success":"true","message":"The form was submitted successfully."}' present for recent submissions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: consider returning 404 when deleting a non-existent id (currently returns 200 success even if nothing was deleted). Low priority.

server.py FORWARD_ORIGIN default is 'https://www.bright.mozeid.com' which does not match the FormSubmit-activated domain in production; verify the current default matches the domain FormSubmit expects. Currently working (200 success:true) so acceptable.
Admin.jsx: token stored in localStorage — acceptable for this app scope but note XSS token exposure risk.
seed_data_creation: Created ~5 QA quote submissions ('QA Test Home', 'QA Log Check', 'QA Test Quote', 'QA Delete Me' [deleted], 'QA Test Home') and ~2 QA applications ('QA Test Applicant', 'QA Test Applicant2') via API + UI. Main agent may clean DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers: root, admin login (good/bad), quote+application create with GET-verified persistence, honeypot, admin auth protection (401/403 on missing/bad tokens), delete flow (create->delete->verify absent), admin summary, and FormSubmit forward log verification. FRONTEND_ENV is read to auto-derive REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All tests pass — safe to deploy to production.
